item.title: Docassemble Expert
item.description:
Field Detail
What it solves Conversational assistant for writing and debugging YAML interviews for the open-source Docassemble framework.
Status Published, with a public demo.
License MIT, “Copyright (c) 2025 Daniel”.
Code HammerDev99/docassemble-expert
Demo docassemble-expert.streamlit.app. The demo uses third-party AI services. Do not enter personal data or information from real cases.
Started First commit: 25 September 2025.
Recognition None.
Authorship Built by the author from a template by another author (template author’s profile), with the author’s own equipment and accounts, without any commission or instruction from any entity or office.

What it does

  • Explains Docassemble’s YAML syntax.
  • Helps design guided interviews with conditional logic.
  • Guides users on generating documents from the answers.

Technologies

Python, Streamlit and the OpenAI Assistants API.

Personal free-software tool, published in a personal capacity. It does not represent the Judicial Branch; using it in a court office requires the corresponding institutional authorizations.
